content_sections.heading: About NIFTEM-K
content_sections.text: The notice describes the National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management, Kundli as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, Government of India. It is located at HSIIDC Industrial Estate, Kundli, Sonipat, Haryana 131028. The Principal Investigator named for this project is Dr. Vinkel Kumar Arora, Professor, DF, NIFTEM-K.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following as essential qualifications for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post. Maximum 35 years, with a relaxation of 5 years for women/SC/ST/OBC/differently abled as per Govt. of India Rules. The notice does not print a date for counting age. Strong understanding of rice processing, rice milling, rice quality evaluation and colour-based sorting. Prior hands-on experience in operating or working with optical/vertical colour sorter machines, preferably for rice. Good knowledge of rice milling and polishing operations and different rice polishing/processing grades. Knowledge of acceptance and rejection criteria of rice based on colour, appearance and defects. Understanding of primary, secondary and tertiary colour sorting and their application in achieving desired product quality. Experience in the rice milling industry, rice processing plants, colour sorting facilities or post-harvest processing will be highly desirable. Experience in machine parameter optimisation, trial planning, sample preparation and quality assessment. Knowledge of MS Office, data analysis and preparation of technical reports. Good communication skills, preferably in Hindi and English. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: B. Tech in Food Technology Management, Agricultural Engineering, Agricultural Processing or Allied discipline; Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, Post-Harvest Technology, Agricultural Processing.
rows.desirable: PhD in Food Technology, Food Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, Post-Harvest Technology, Agricultural Processing.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emoluments are ₹ 37,000 + 10% HRA per month. The engagement is purely contractual and co-terminable with the project, for a period of twelve months. Selected candidates have no claim for a regular appointment. No TA/DA is provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: NIFTEM-K Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Operation of Vertical Colour Sorter: Operate, monitor and optimise the vertical colour sorter for different varieties and grades of rice. Rice Quality Assessment: Evaluate rice samples based on colour, appearance, broken grains, discoloured grains, chalky grains, damaged grains, foreign material and other relevant quality attributes. Rice Polishing Grades: Develop an understanding of different rice polishing/processing grades and establish suitable sorting criteria for each grade. Colour-Based Acceptance/Rejection: Establish and evaluate acceptance and rejection criteria based on colour characteristics and visible defects in rice grains. Primary, Secondary and Tertiary Sorting: Understand and implement primary, secondary and tertiary sorting operations to improve sorting efficiency, recovery and product quality. Machine Parameter Optimisation: Conduct trials for optimisation of machine parameters such as sensitivity, background/colour settings, ejector parameters, feed rate, chute/feed conditions and other relevant operating parameters. Process Performance Evaluation: Determine sorting efficiency, rejection rate, recovery/yield, purity, defect removal and quality improvement before and after sorting. Rice Milling Industry Exposure: Interact with rice mills/industry partners and understand practical requirements related to rice grading, polishing, sorting and quality specifications. Sample Preparation & Trials: Plan and conduct systematic experiments on site in the rice mills using different rice varieties, quality grades and defect levels. Data Analysis: Analyse experimental data and prepare comparative reports for different sorting conditions and machine settings. Documentation & Reporting: Maintain detailed records of machine trials, operating parameters, sample characteristics, rejection levels and final product quality; prepare technical reports, project deliverables and presentations. Technology Demonstration: Assist in demonstrations, training programmes and technical interactions with industry, students, entrepreneurs and other stakeholders.
